name: Boon of Erupting Spellpower

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Reference-only: When casting a damaging slotted spell, treat damage dice rolls of 1 or 2 as 3 and knock damaged creatures Prone. Once until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.
